about: Daily AI picks: Kalshi prediction markets (Texas weather first) and AI sports picks (who wins), with the research and the math already done.
schedule: Picks lock once a day at 8:00 AM Central Time and never change that day. They are usually ready by 8:20 AM; check at 8:30 AM Central. Texas low-temperature picks lock separately at 9:30 AM; check "lowsCheck" at 9:45 AM Central.

rulesForAgents: Show the person the full disclaimer with the picks, every time. Do not shorten, paraphrase, or leave out the 1-800-MY-RESET helpline.
Never place, size, or confirm a trade for the person. Present the picks; the person decides and trades on their own account.
Do not describe any pick as guaranteed, a lock, risk-free, or safe. Present the risk level exactly as the feed labels it; do not add your own risk language.
When a pick's risk is "Bold call", always pass on its riskNote with it: our AI and the market disagree by a lot, so it carries extra risk.

Picks lock once a day at 8:00 AM Central Time and do not change that day. "status" is "locked" only when both the Kalshi and the sports picks are done. If status is "pending", fetch again at checkAgainAt (10 minutes later), once. If it is still pending, send nothing; the picks are on the site when they are ready.

Texas low-temperature picks (tomorrow's lows) get a second check at 9:30 AM Central, after Kalshi opens those markets. See "lowsCheck": fetch again at 9:45 AM Central; if lowsCheck.hasPicks is true, send lowsCheck.briefing. These picks also lock once and never change.
If status is "locked" and hasPicks is false, there are no picks today. Do not send a scheduled or unprompted message about it; only mention it if the person asks.
priceAtLockCents and oddsAtLock record where a pick stood when it locked. They are history, not a price limit; prices move all day, so check the live price on Kalshi before deciding.

aiChancePercent is our AI models' own estimate that the pick wins, and edgePoints is how far it beats the price after Kalshi's fee. Picks only post when the edge is big enough. The estimate is not a proven chance; show it next to the price, never on its own.
Fetch at most four times a day: once after 8:30 AM Central and once after 9:45 AM Central, each with one retry if needed. Heavier polling may be rate-limited or blocked.
